content: An'kab a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl
Làleŋ ukwen, làkäl anà un'kanà ntɔn indiir a Dweelà, sin sin ngɔɔm.
Ntɔn, mbuur afàyäm unsà ndaa mpa bàfàyɔb baar, ufàyäm anki anà baar, wɛɛ anà Nzam. Ntɔn akà mbuur mwɛy ufàyöb anki ndaa ande. Kyekà, u ngwal a Dweelà, nde afàkyään indiir aŋàyee.
Wɛɛ mbuur afàtà ngɔɔm afàyäm anà baar ntɔn mutɔŋ anà mupà ngwal.
Mbuur afàyäm u ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar, afàtɔŋ nde ŋakwo, wɛɛ mbuur afàtà ngɔɔm afàtɔŋ nkööŋ.

Mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ banswà làtɛn u ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar, wɛɛ mɛ inkwen mbɔɔn naa bɛ làsöönà mutà ngɔɔm. Mbuur afàtà ngɔɔm kan'söön mbuur afàyäm u ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar, nà isàkal naa nde kan'baal ya ntɔn mutɔŋ làkwikilà a Ikööŋ.

Atɔŋ, bi itàsii apanà naa mɛ in'yàlaler anà mɛ in'yäm anà bɛ u ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar, nkye mɛ in'sàkal mfun nà akà bɛ, isàkal naa ndaa amɛ yàlatwääl anki itàkal imɛɛy, itàkal ngyööb, itàkal ngɔɔm, itàkal an'lɔɔŋ?
Abun, ya yà ifà imwɛy asànaa indiir a ikwɛŋ, asànaa saay a mfuŋ itàkal naa nkwaay: Isàkal naa bya ikatoo anki byànsöön, abun baar bàyàyöb aben naa saay a mfuŋ anà nkwaay ininà itɛɛnà?
Abun, isàkal naa saay a mfuŋ làtwey anki ndaa ubwaŋàbwaŋ, nà kan'kwo muyöŋà ntɔn ità?
Ya ye abun sye ntɔn bɛ: isàkal naa làlem abɛ làtweyà anki ndaa a un'yɛnà, baar bàyàyöb aben ndaa làtɛɛnà bɛ? Bɛ làyàyäm amu un'pöb.
U mɛɛn mà ndaa a ifà ifà yà mbɔɔn, wɛɛ akà mwɛy tɛy uboo a ya ikɔ̈ɔ̈n mbuul.
Abun, isàkal naa mɛ in'yöb anki mbuul a ndaa, mɛ in'yàkal ungyey akà mbuur ayäämà, mbuur ayäämà ayàkal ungyey akà mɛ.
Abun bɛ sye, ntɔn bɛ làfàkal anà ngyal mbɔɔn yà indiir a Dweelà, làleŋ mukal abyà byàŋàsöönà, wɛɛ bya ikäl ntɔn ntööŋ a Ikööŋ.
Kyakin mbuur afàyäm u ndaa a ingyey akyer ayamà ntɔn muwal kab abaal ndaa ayin.
Isàkal naa mɛ an'yamà u ndaa a ingyey, dweelà amɛ làkayamà, wɛɛ un'yɛnà amɛ ubɔr anki undiir.
Waa mɛ in'kyer aben? Mɛ in'sàyamà unsà Dweelà, wɛɛ mɛɛ in'sàyamà sye anà un'yɛnà, mɛ in'sàtɔl an'diim unsà Dweelà, wɛɛ mɛ in'sàtɔl an'diim sye anà un'yɛnà amɛ.

Ntɔn, isàkal naa ngye an'sà nsaak anà Dweelà mpɛl, nkye mbuur awà uboo a baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ngwem, an'kwo utɛn naa: « Abwɛy » unsà ngyamàkà angye yà an'tɔɔn? Ntɔn nde uyöb anki ndaa atɛɛnà ngye.
Yà ndandaa naa mfuur a an'tɔɔn angye yà ntsà, wɛɛ mbuur wumwɛy uyɛl anki unsà làkwikilà ande.
Mɛ an'fuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam ntɔn in'yäämà mɛ u ndaa a ingyey yàŋàlyaaŋ bɛ banswà,
wɛɛ uboo a Ikööŋ, mɛ in'kwen mutɛn ngɔk tyeen unsà un'yɛnà amɛ, ntɔn mulɔŋ bumwɛy sye, akwànaa ngɔk nsaab kweem unsà ndaa a ingyey.
Atɔŋ, unsà an'kyän, twon lan'kal ambɛy. Ndandaa, làkäl ambɛy ntɔn ube, wɛɛ ntɔn an'kyän, làkäl andweer.
Unsà un'kɔɔn bàsön naa:

content.text: « Mwol kan'tɛn naa: Akà un'sɛŋ wà, Mɛ in'sàtɛn u mbwo a baar a ndaa asin
anà u mbwo a mun a angyey.
Itàkal abun, ba mɛ bàsan'wem anki." »

content: Abun, ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar yà idiim ntɔn baar mpa abà aŋàlàkwikilà, wɛɛ kà ntɔn aŋàlàkwikilà anki. Ngɔɔm yà idiim ntɔn aŋàlàkwikilà, wɛɛ kà ntɔn baar mpa abà aŋàlàkwikilà anki.

Isàkal naa Ikööŋ kyanswà kyan'köŋ, anà baar banswà bàyäm u ndaa a ingyey, isàkal sye naa baar asin itàkal baar bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà bà mwo, nkye ba bàyàtɛn anki naa bɛ làbà anà ukɔŋ?
Mper yumwɛy, isàkal naa ba banswà bàmutà ngɔɔm, mbuur asin itàkal mbuur akɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà kan'bilà kwo, nde ayàman naa ba banswà bàtɛɛnà a nde anà bàtsüülà nde mbar.

Indiir aŋàyee u mpem ande imɛnà u mii, nde ayàkömà Nzam anà ayàkyään naa Nzam wà uboo a nde, nde ayàtüüb ntabwey ande anà mɛɛn, nde ayàkömà Nzam anà ayàkyään naa ndandaa Nzam wà uboo a bɛ.
Swalaa uboo a Ikööŋ
Atɔŋ, bi itsülà aben? Utaaŋ làfàköŋ bɛ, mbuur mbuur uboo a bɛ an'kwo mutɔl diim, mutwaal an'lɔɔŋ itàkal imɛɛy, mutɛn ndaa a ingyey itàkal mubaal ya: wɛy ya yanswà ikäl ntɔn mutɔŋ Ikööŋ.
Isàkal naa baar bàyäm u ndaa a ingyey, wɛy abɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal atär mpɛl bàyäm, anà bàkyer umwɛy ungö a wumwɛy, anà mbuur abaal ya ukäl.
Isàkal naa un'baal watɛy, wɛy un'tɔŋ ukäl a duu uboo a nköŋ, wɛy nde uyäm a nde ŋakwo anà a Nzam.
Akà aŋangɔɔm, wɛy abɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal atär bàwɛl ndaa, wɛy bumwɛy bàsyebà.
Isàkal naa umwɛy uboo a nköŋ kan'wal imɛɛy, wɛy mbuur ayäämà ukäl a duu.
Bɛ banswà lan'kwo mutà ngɔɔm, wɛɛ mbuur mbuur utaaŋ ande, ntɔn baar banswà bàlɔŋàkà anà bàwɛl ngwal.
An'dweelà a aŋangɔɔm mà ungyɛl a aŋangɔɔm.
Ntɔn Nzam kà wà Nzam a lingyoomà anki, wɛɛ Nzam a duu. Asànaa bàfàkyer ya uboo a Ikööŋ byanswà byà aŋin'kyɛɛl,
wɛy akaar bàkäl a duu uboo a nköŋ: ba mbwo bapɛ anki mutɛn. Wɛy ba bàläb ayà itɛɛnà Un'kɔɔn.
Isàkal naa ba bàkwen muyöb undiir mwɛy, wɛy mbuur mbuur ufuul un'dim ande u ndwà. Ntɔn yà nswɛn naa un'kaar usi ndaa uboo a nköŋ.
Nkye ndaa a Nzam yàfü akà bɛ? Nkye ya bɛ mpɛl làwɛl?
Isàkal naa mbuur asii naa nde wà ŋangɔɔm itàkal wàŋadweelà, wɛy nde ukyey naa indiir in'kàlasöönà mɛ byà nswɛɛŋ mwɛy yà Mwol.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy ukyeyà anki ya, iswaŋà naa Nzam kun'yöb anki.
Kyakin, atɔŋ amɛ, làkäl anà ilɛɛm mukal aŋangɔɔm, twon lan'tsuŋ mbuur mutɛn unsà ndaa mpa bàfàyöb baar.
Wɛɛ, wɛy indiir byanswà ikäl u mbwo anà byàswalaa.
